import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long[] a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextLong();
        }
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        Arrays.sort(a);
        long ans = 0;
        int left = 0;
        for (int right = 0; right < n; right++) {
            while (a[right] - a[left] > k) {
                left++;
            }
            ans = Math.max(ans, (long)(right - left + 1));
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
